chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar and Ibn Sinan and Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Obedience to Ali (peace be upon him) is humiliation (in this world), and disobedience to him is disbelief in Allah.' It was said, 'O Rasool-Allah, and how can obedience to Ali (peace be upon him) be humiliation and disobedience to him be disbelief in Allah?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, Ali (peace be upon him) carries you upon the Truth, so if you obey him, you will be humbled, and if you disobey him, you will have disbelieved in Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'

key_terms.يَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَى الْحَقِّ: He carries you upon the Truth

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between obeying Imam Ali and disbelief in Allah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) elucidates the metaphysical reality of obedience to Imam Ali (peace be upon him) by linking it directly to the believer's submission to divine truth. The apparent paradox of 'obedience being humiliation' is resolved by understanding that following the Imam subdues the ego (nafs) to the Will of Allah, whereas disobedience constitutes a rejection of that divine authority, amounting to kufr. This highlights the Shia doctrine of Wilayat al-Faqih's precursor, where the Imam serves as the living embodiment of the Quran and the path to salvation.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Yahya Bin Al Mubarak, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Is’haq Bin Ammar and Ibn Sinan and Sama’at, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘Obeying Aliasws is suffering (in this world) and disobeying himasws is disbelief (Kufr) in Allahazwj’. It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allahsaww! And how can obedience to Aliasws be a suffering (in this world) and disobedience to himasws be disbelief (Kufr) in Allahazwj?’ Hesaww said: ‘Aliasws carries you all upon the Truth, so if you were to obey himasws you will suffer, but if you were to disobey himasws, you would have disbelieved in Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 17. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Yahya ibn al- Mubarak from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jabalah from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar and ibn Sinan and Sama’a from abu Basir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Obedience to Ali (a.s.) is suffering (in this world) and disobedience to him is disbelief in Allah.’ It was said, ‘O Messenger of Allah, how can obedience to Ali (a.s.) be suffering and disobedience to him disbelief in Allah?’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘Ali (a.s.) leads you to the truth. If you obey him you will suffer and if you disobey him you will become unbelievers in Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy.’”
